DEV fully redeployed (site + worker); rehearsal verdict READY for ~Wed. PROD untouched and still held. Integration branch feat/weekend-fast-follows pushed to origin; merge to main awaits decision 3.

Matter polish deepened the 5 genuinely-thinnest matters (m11/m12/m13/m14/m16): 3 new interviewable personas elevated from existing witnesses, a real fact mis-anchor fixed in m11 — all validator-gated, no invention. (2) Both DWI matters stay at 2 personas as an intentional shape norm — say the word if you want a neutral third later.
